info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Oracle WebLogic Server Deployment Application Deployments Server Runtime API
Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get server runtime tree root

items.docs: Returns the root resource of the server runtime MBean tree for the server handling the request.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get JVM runtime information

items.docs: Returns JVM runtime information including heap usage, uptime, and Java version for the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get thread pool runtime information

items.docs: Returns thread pool runtime information including active threads, queue length, and throughput metrics for the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get JDBC service runtime information

items.docs: Returns JDBC service runtime information including data source runtimes and connection pool metrics.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all JDBC data source runtimes

items.docs: Returns runtime information for all JDBC data sources on the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get a JDBC data source runtime

params.name: dataSourceName
params.description: The name of the JDBC data source

items.docs: Returns runtime information for a specific JDBC data source.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get JMS runtime information

items.docs: Returns JMS runtime information including JMS server runtimes and connection statistics for the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all JMS server runtimes

items.docs: Returns runtime information for all JMS servers on the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs List all application runtimes

items.docs: Returns runtime information for all deployed applications on the current server.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get an application runtime

params.name: appName
params.description: The name of the deployed application

items.docs: Returns runtime information for a specific deployed application.
